results.raw_content: The event-stream npm package, which averaged close to two million downloads a week, was compromised when its original maintainer handed publish rights to an unknown contributor. The new maintainer added flatmap-stream as a dependency in version 3.3.6. That package contained obfuscated malicious code designed to steal credentials from the Copay bitcoin wallet application. npm removed the malicious versions after a developer spotted suspicious behaviour in the dependency tree.
results.title: Popular npm package event-stream compromised to steal bitcoin wallets
